origin: Manual bounded restoration input adapter for proposal validation, not an extractor/merge run or source-correctness claim.

untranslated.source:
Bringing about the darkest days of the Spellblaze you hasten the death of your foes.
		When you deal damage to a creature in radius %d or less around you and it dips below 33%% life you automatically unleash the fury of the Spellblaze.
		Affected foes will start taking %0.2f darkness damage each turn until it dies as long as it remains in radius %d of you.
		The damage increases with spellpower.
untranslated.previous_target:
通过引发魔法大爆炸最黑暗的时候的场景，你加速了敌人的死亡。
		每次你对半径 %d 内的生物造成伤害后（实际触发范围固定为 4 格，不随该数值变化），如果它生命值低于 33%%，将会承受魔法大爆炸的力量。
		受影响的敌人每回合会受到 %0.2f 暗影伤害；只要它仍在你周围半径 %d 内，伤害就会持续直至其死亡。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

untranslated.source: The target is surrounded by a magical shield, absorbing %d/%d damage before it crumbles and dealing %d damage in a radius of %d when it does.
untranslated.previous_target: 目标被一层魔法护盾包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害，护盾结束时（无论吸收耗尽还是自然到期），对周围敌方生物施加持续 3 回合的灼烧，总计造成 %d 伤害，作用半径为 %d。
